rationale.conceptual: The method involves spin-polarized DFT with PBE, dispersion/solvation corrections, and CHE model for free energies—a well-established but multi-component workflow that requires careful implementation of thermodynamic corrections and stability criteria, typical of a non-trivial computational catalysis screening study.
rationale.execution: The pipeline has 7+ stages: model building (210 SACs), stability DFT for all, O* adsorption DFT for ~149 stable SACs, full free-energy diagram for one catalyst, and multiple scored artifacts. Orchestrating hundreds of DFT calculations with correct inputs, error handling, and handoffs is a substantial engineering challenge.
